mapper.select: SELECT t_department.*, t_employee.actual_name AS managerName, parent_department.department_name AS parentName FROM t_department LEFT JOIN t_employee ON t_department.manager_id = t_employee.employee_id LEFT JOIN t_department parent_department ON t_department.parent_id = parent_department.department_id ORDER BY sort DESC
